name: impact-preview
title: Impact Preview
description: Delete confirmation that loads every dependent of a parent object, grouped by type with counts and samples and marked deleted, detached or kept, and keeps Confirm locked until the list has loaded.

meta.stops: Helps prevent a cascade delete wiping child records
meta.summary: Before a delete, loads and lists everything that goes with the parent object, so a cascade doesn't wipe child records nobody saw.
meta.server: Run the delete in a transaction with the same cascade rules and authorization on the server.
catches: Child records a cascade will delete
Records that will be detached rather than deleted
Confirming before the impact has loaded: Confirm stays locked
limits: Accurate only if your load function mirrors the real cascade rules
The list can be stale if data changes between preview and delete
Not authorization; it doesn't decide who may delete
a11y: Dialog content labelled by its title and aria-busy while loading
Loading text in a polite live region; errors use role=alert
Groups expand with aria-expanded and aria-controls
Locked Confirm uses aria-disabled so it stays focusable
